description: Calibration questions for the grounding gate (Day 3) and seed of the Day 7 golden set, over the 10-document corpus. In-corpus questions carry a verbatim evidence phrase; 'expected' lists every page of the whole corpus where that phrase appears (table-of-contents pages excluded), because the same passage often repeats across the framework and the pillars. 'intendedFile' is the document the question was written from. Tag 'paraphrase' marks questions with little keyword overlap with their page. Types: IN_CORPUS; OUT_FAR (unrelated topic); OUT_NEAR (same domain, not AWS-specific content); OUT_AWS (an AWS question whose specific answer is not in these PDFs). Out-of-corpus questions list terms verified absent from the corpus. Split: every 4th question of each type is held out and not used to choose the threshold. Widening (added after the first calibration runs): 'expected' stays the strict set fixed before any run; 'expectedWidened' adds, with the reason in 'widenedNotes', (1) the page before and after each strictly expected page and (2) for in-10, in-11, in-31 and in-32 a quoted sentence that answers the question in other words, on every page where it appears. Reports give both strict and widened numbers.
